classification.official_reason: Formal 01 detected and assigned the plant semantic region, but robot-local navigation did not complete semantic arrival before the episode runtime timeout.
classification.basis: Robot 1's short local trajectory prefixes caused alternating wall-front yaw requests during exploration. Robot 0 later received a valid semantic route and repeated non-zero bridge commands, but the measured pose stopped responding before arrival.

metrics.standard_shortest_path_status: not required for this failed episode's zero SPL contribution

behavior: Robot 1 explored during the early rounds; near a wall, its collision-scored local trajectory repeatedly collapsed to a short prefix whose bearing crossed the body axis, producing alternating left/right yaw requests.
Robot 0's exploration path was physically consistent with the selected route.
The plant semantic region was first selected for Robot 0 in round 12 and remained selected through the terminal rounds.
Robot 0 produced a valid local route and repeated non-zero angular commands, and the Go2 bridge logged matching Move calls; measured yaw then remained nearly unchanged.
The semantic leg was retried after LOCAL_PLANNER_PATH_STALE and LOCAL_PLANNER_NO_PROGRESS, then the episode failed closed at its runtime limit.
